message:
- **You push it**, Instructions: Service Center (https://<env>/ServiceCenter) → Factory → Applications → open each app → Download for a .oap package per app, or Service Studio → Module menu → Export → Save As for a single .oml; for table data, Service Studio → Data tab → right-click entity → View Data → export to Excel, per entity. Lands as .oap/.oml app packages plus one .xlsx per entity on your disk, there is no self-service full-database download on OutSystems Cloud.
- **We pull it**, Instructions: file a ticket with OutSystems Support for Direct Database Access with a read-only database user, choosing IP allowlisting and giving them our egress IPs; they return a file with the database address and username and send the password via SMS. Also create a LifeTime token via LifeTime console → User Management → Service Accounts → New Service Account (read-only role), then paste the DB address, username, password, and token into a one-time link at scrt.link and email us that link.

Let me know if you would prefer to push this one or have us pull it!
notes: No self-service full-database download exists on OutSystems Cloud; the pull route depends on an OutSystems Support ticket.
Push-route table data is exported per entity to Excel, not as raw database files.
